purpose: Teach: に当たって/満たし/満たさ/遂げ/併せ/略し/測っ/揃える

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 交渉に当たって留意点を整理しましょう
lines.en: Let's organize the key points to keep in mind for the negotiation.
lines.style: Crisp, professional opening. Brisk pace with clear articulation. A manager setting the agenda — purposeful and direct, but not cold. Light emphasis on 'organize' as the actionable word.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。条件を満たしております
lines.en: Yes. The conditions are being met.
lines.style: Prompt, attentive confirmation. Slight nod in the voice. Steady, reassuring tone — showing readiness to move forward. No hesitation, but not rushed.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 規定を満たさない案件は却下しましょう
lines.en: Let's reject any cases that don't meet the regulations.
lines.style: Clear directive tone. Measured and firm. The word 'reject' lands with quiet authority — not harsh, just decisive. Deliberate pacing that signals this is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。目標を遂げました
lines.style: Satisfied, brief report. Confident delivery on 'achieved' — a small note of accomplishment without boasting. Professional completion. Eyes forward to the next task.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 各国の数字を併せて報告しましょう
lines.en: Let's combine the figures from each country and report them together.
lines.style: Task-oriented instruction. Steady pace, methodical. The manager coordinating across regions — calm authority. Slight emphasis on 'combine' to signal consolidation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。長い社名を略して通称を決めました
lines.en: Yes. I've arranged to have the long company name abbreviated and settled on a shorthand version.
lines.style: Informative update delivered with quiet efficiency. Slightly warmer than the previous — showing initiative taken. Even pace, no apology, just facts handled.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 反応を測って次の手を考えましょう
lines.en: Let's gauge the reaction and think through what we do next.
lines.style: Forward-looking directive. Thoughtful and strategic rather than reactive. Slight pause before 'next' — inviting him to consider with you. Measured but engaged.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。書類を揃えるよう手配しました
lines.en: Yes. I've arranged for all the documents to be gathered.
lines.style: Final confirmation, slightly warming. Professional closure — task completed. Calm, reliable delivery. The sense of moving toward closure without fanfare.
